name: Oregon

sales.rateNote: Oregon has no general sales or use/transaction tax. It levies a 0.5% vehicle privilege tax (on dealers selling new vehicles) and a matching vehicle use tax on new vehicles bought out of state.

scheduledChanges.what: State transient lodging tax (not a sales tax) rises from 1.5% to 2.75%; the extra 1.25% must appear on receipts as a 'nature conservation fee'.

local.levies: No general local sales tax per the Department of Revenue; cities and counties levy their own transient lodging taxes.
local.capNote: Local lodging tax rates are set by each city or county.

groceries.note: No general sales tax, so groceries are not taxed.

clothing.note: No general sales tax, so clothing is not taxed.

otherRates.item: new vehicles (vehicle privilege tax / vehicle use tax)
otherRates.note: 0.5% of the retail price of taxable vehicles (7,500 miles or less, 26,000 lb GVWR or less, never titled in Oregon); privilege tax on Oregon dealers, use tax on out-of-state dealer purchases, due within 30 days.
1.5% for stays ending on or before December 31, 2026; 2.75% from January 1, 2027. Local lodging taxes are additional.

sales.holidayNote: Not applicable: Oregon has no general sales tax.

useTax.note: No general use tax; only the 0.5% vehicle use tax applies to new vehicles bought from out-of-state dealers.

facts.text: Oregon has no general sales or use tax; the only use tax is the vehicle use tax on new vehicles bought out of state, which must be paid before titling.
The 0.5% vehicle privilege tax and vehicle use tax both began on January 1, 2018.
Corporate Activity Tax (since 2020): $250 plus 0.57% of Oregon taxable commercial activity above $1 million, paid by the business, not itemized as a sales tax.
Businesses must register for the CAT within 30 days of reaching $750,000 of Oregon commercial activity in a year.
The state lodging tax is 1.5% through 2026 and 2.75% from January 1, 2027; stays that start in 2026 and end in 2027 pay the new rate on the whole stay.
Oregon law does not let residents reduce Oregon taxes for sales tax paid in another state.

property.levied: local only: more than 1,200 local taxing districts (counties, cities, school districts, special districts); county assessors value most property and collect the tax

assessment.text: Each property is taxed on the lesser of its real market value (RMV) and its maximum assessed value (MAV). Under Measure 50 (1997) MAV can grow no more than 3% a year unless the property changes (new structure, improvement, partition). Measure 5 (1990) caps operating taxes at $5 per $1,000 of RMV for schools and $10 per $1,000 for general government.
assessment.capText: Each property is taxed on the lesser of its real market value (RMV) and its maximum assessed value (MAV). Under Measure 50 (1997) MAV can grow no more than 3% a year unless the property changes (new structure, improvement, partition). Measure 5 (1990) caps operating taxes at $5 per $1,000 of RMV for schools and $10 per $1,000 for general government.

homestead.name: None (no statewide homestead exemption)
homestead.text: Oregon has no statewide general homestead exemption and no exemption based only on age or income; seniors and disabled homeowners can instead defer taxes.

otherRelief.name: Senior and Disabled Property Tax Deferral
otherRelief.text: The state pays the county taxes each November 15 and places a lien accruing 6% simple interest. 2026 household income limit $70,000; RMV minimum cap $301,000. Apply to the county assessor January 1-April 15 (late until December 1 with a fee).

otherRelief.name: Disabled Veteran or Surviving Spouse Exemption
otherRelief.text: Exempts a portion of the homestead's assessed value for disabled veterans and surviving spouses or registered domestic partners.

otherRelief.name: Active-Duty Military Exemption
otherRelief.text: Deployed Oregon National Guard or Reserve members may exempt part of their primary residence's assessed value.

dueDates.text: Due November 15. Full payment by November 15 earns a 3% discount and two-thirds payment a 2% discount; otherwise thirds are due November 15, February 15 and May 15.

facts.text: In FY 2025-26 property taxes imposed averaged $17.52 per $1,000 of assessed value and $9.40 per $1,000 of real market value.
When Measure 5 limits are exceeded, taxes are 'compressed': local option levies are reduced first.
Minor construction under $18,200 in one year or $45,000 over five years doesn't trigger an exception to the 3% MAV cap; those thresholds are CPI-indexed after 2024.
Household furnishings, personal belongings, automobiles, crops and business inventories are not subject to property tax.
Value appeals go to the county Property Value Appeals Board and must be filed by December 31.
Local option taxes are limited to five years for operations and ten years for capital construction.

uncertain: Some Oregon cities may levy local taxes on specific items (e.g. meals); not verified on an official page, so local.allowed reflects only the DOR statement that Oregon has no general sales tax.
